notes.content: Computer information technology - CSU Northridge General Education

Engineering and Computer Science majors may follow CSU Northridge GE Plan instead of Cal-GETC. Computer Information Technology students are required to take courses in the following CSU GE areas: CSU Northridge GE English Composition - Written Communication (3 units) = CSU GE Area 1A Oral Communication (3 units) = CSU GE Area 1C Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning (3 units) = CSU GE Area 2 Arts (3 units) = CSU GE Area 3A Humanities (3 units) = CSU GE Area 3B Social and Behavioral Sciences (3 units) = CSU GE Area 4 Physical Science (3 units) = CSU GE Area 5A Biological Science (3 units) = CSU GE Area 5B Science Laboratory Activity (1 unit) = CSU GE Area 5C Ethnic Studies (3 units) = CSU GE Area 6 CSUN Section F - Comparative Cultural Studies (3 units) U.S. History and Government (6 units) = CSU US History, Constitution, and American Ideals Students applying to majors in the College of Engineering and Computer Science do not need CSU GE-Critical Thinking 1B prior to admission.
notes.contentHtml:
Engineering and Computer Science majors may follow CSU Northridge GE Plan instead of Cal-GETC.


Computer Information Technology students are required to take courses in the following CSU GE areas: CSU Northridge GE

  • English Composition - Written Communication (3 units) = CSU GE Area 1A
  • Oral Communication (3 units) = CSU GE Area 1C
  • Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning (3 units) = CSU GE Area 2
  • Arts (3 units) = CSU GE Area 3A
  • Humanities (3 units) = CSU GE Area 3B
  • Social and Behavioral Sciences (3 units) = CSU GE Area 4
  • Physical Science (3 units) = CSU GE Area 5A
  • Biological Science (3 units) = CSU GE Area 5B
  • Science Laboratory Activity (1 unit) = CSU GE Area 5C
  • Ethnic Studies (3 units) = CSU GE Area 6
  • CSUN Section F - Comparative Cultural Studies (3 units)
  • U.S. History and Government (6 units) = CSU US History, Constitution, and American Ideals


Students applying to majors in the College of Engineering and Computer Science do not need CSU GE-Critical Thinking 1B prior to admission.
